annotations.title: New and recent Thai visa rules

description: Use this when someone asks what changed or what is new in Thai visa and immigration rules: "new Thailand visa rules 2026", "did the visa exemption change", "Thailand 30 day rule", "latest DTV changes", "retirement visa changes 2026", "Thailand Elite price change", "is the Thailand entry fee in force", "what changed since 2024". Returns dated changes, newest first, with in-force, announced, proposed or disputed status and sources. Optional filter by topic (a route or "entry") and by date. Do not use for the full rules of one route (thai_visa_details).

include_pending.description: Include announced, proposed and disputed changes (default true).

since.description: Optional: only changes on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

topic.description: Optional: a route ("DTV", "retirement visa", "Thailand Elite", "LTR") or "entry" for visa exemption and arrival rules.

name: thai_visa_rule_changes

scope.description: answered, compared, or needs_input (then ask the user "question" first).

title: New and recent Thai visa rules
